summary: The official Gringos & Mariachis site and Bethesda Toast surface confirm the Cordell Avenue restaurant and its complete current menu. Eighty-nine frozen products remain current. Seven explicitly seasonal special items from the prior catalog are absent from the current summer menu and marked stale, while the extracted 'Soup, Sushi & Salads' category heading is an artifact. Required searches found no product-level restaurant-issued allergen matrix. The official cross-contact warning for gluten and nuts is recorded, explicit ingredient-derived positives are retained for current products, and no unsupported allergen absence claims are made.
